_about: Template for the per-box shrub build recipe (plugins/trees/README.md, Rebuilding the shrubs). Copy it to the private files and fill in every <...> value; never commit the filled copy. Each box's utm is its extent in grid metres (EPSG:32611), from basemap/ground/spec.json.
_flags: Each key maps to a build_shrubs.py option: dsm, dtm, mask, photo, points, crop, lidar, lidar_date, photo_shift (auto or east,north in metres), skip_rects (--skip-rect, repeatable), out (--out).

a.mask: <the box's building mask, .npy on the DSM grid>
a.photo: <the box's NAIP crop: red, green, blue, near-infrared>
points: <the box's LAS/LAZ tiles, or an EPT's ept.json>
a.lidar: <the lidar's name, as its source states it>
